title: Planner Agent in Copilot Chat: task assignment, scheduled catch-up and memory
summary: The briefing passes: the supplied notice supports the default-on change, licence requirement and December 4 act-by date, and Microsoft Learn supports the printed controls. Minor corrections should keep delivery dates tentative, simplify the memory API call, cite the source for Planner permissions and remove the reporting checklist step that has no controls row.
